subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HCR22
title: Encourages Oregon counties that have not already done so to create and adopt a natural resource plan and invoke and enforce coordination with all federal and state agencies.
headline: HCR 22 did not pass

claims.text: HCR 22 was introduced in the House on February 25, 2025.
HCR 22 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
